name: Lada Dexter
source:
Around 14 years old, half-elf.
Star Sign: Cancer
Occupation: Necromancer

He looks like a girl but he's a fearsome magician who can use powerful black magic.
He's doted upon by Alfried and the girls and to be honest he's quite selfish.
In more than just his looks he's pretty childish.
